games.description: Sark works through several nightmare challenges built around clowns, timed keys, glowing orbs, and disguises. The solo run reaches the house’s tight costume-spawn timer but remains unfinished after repeated attempts.
games.title: Eleonor's Nightmares

games.description: A solo Indonesian horror adventure through a haunted forest and looping mansion. Sark shoots crawling hands, buys supplies, gets past the memory safe and clock-door sequence, then returns to finish the remaining mansion clues and reach the abrupt conclusion.
games.title: Exorcism Ritual

games.description: A failed first launch followed by a solo house exploration on the next stream. Sark searches for keys, manages the lighter, opens the parents’ room, and leaves after being unable to find the next route.
games.title: Heart attack

games.description: A brief first attempt leads to a longer return to the shrinking-star hotel. Sark searches guest rooms, the casino and swimming pool for codes while piecing together Brenda and Angelika’s family history.
games.title: Starless Hotel

games.description: Sark searches a haunted house for fuses, keys and evidence of a troubled relationship before reaching the school. A return to the school checkpoint brings more locker puzzles and a stubborn saw interaction before the ending.
games.title: Stay Still
